info.title: Intelligent Tracker API
info.description: Household task tracker. Log in (or complete setup) to receive a session cookie and a CSRF token; send the token in the `X-CSRF-Token` header on every request that changes something. Errors are `{ "error": code, "message": text }`.

get.description: Always 200 while the api is up. With a database it also reports the worker heartbeat: `stale` is set when there is none or it is over 5 minutes old.

post.summary: Create the household and its first admin

patch.summary: Set when a member is away until
patch.description: Rotating tasks skip the member for dues up to and including `awayUntil` (a household-local date); `null` clears it. Members set their own, admins anyone in the household. Open occurrences of the member's rotations are re-planned straight away.

post.summary: Start a password reset for a member (admin)
Use a invite link to set a password
Use a reset link to set a password

get.description: The household's active tasks by title, or its archived ones with `archived=true`.

post.description: Creates the task and materialises its occurrences straight away. A schedule the recurrence engine rejects (such as an unparseable RRULE) is `invalid_schedule`.

patch.description: Send only the fields to change (`null` clears an optional one). The result must be a valid task as a whole. Changing the schedule replaces the task's upcoming and active occurrences from today on; started, completed and overdue ones are kept. `archived: true` hides the task and removes its open occurrences; `false` restores it.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the task, its occurrences, assignees and milestones.

post.summary: Accept or dismiss a history-based suggestion
post.description: Requires a household session and CSRF token. Missing or invalid CSRF tokens return 403.

403.description: Missing or invalid CSRF token, or cross-origin request

schema.description: Missing or invalid CSRF token, or cross-origin request

post.description: Marks an open occurrence done. For an `after_completion` task the next occurrence is created straight away and returned as `next`.
Like completing, but recorded as skipped. An `after_completion` task still moves on to its next occurrence.
Hides an open occurrence from the today and overdue views until `until` (which must be in the future) or for `days` days.
Marks an upcoming or active occurrence as started (and ends any snooze). Starting one that is already started changes nothing.

put.description: Marks one of the task's milestones as done (or not done) on an open occurrence. A ticked milestone stops its reminder and is skipped as the next milestone; unticking it lets the reminder be planned again if it is still in the future. Setting what is already set changes nothing. A milestone that is not the task's is a 404.

get.description: Open occurrences of active tasks that are not snoozed. `today` (the default) is everything due today or earlier, already within its lead time, or undated, overdue first; `overdue` only what is past due; `upcoming` what is due from tomorrow up to `days` days ahead. "Today" is the household's local day.
The newest in-app notifications for the logged-in member, newest first. `unreadCount` counts every unread one, not only those returned.

post.description: Marking one that is already read changes nothing.

get.description: `publicKey` is the VAPID public key to pass to `PushManager.subscribe` as the application server key. It is null when the deployment has not configured push, in which case the web app does not offer it.

post.description: Takes `PushSubscription.toJSON()`. Saving the same endpoint again refreshes its keys, and an endpoint that another member had saved (a shared device) moves to the caller. A member keeps at most 20 subscriptions: saving more drops the least recently saved. The endpoint must be an https URL of a browser push service (Google, Apple, Mozilla or Windows), as the worker sends to it; any other host is a 400. Answers 409 `push_not_configured` when the deployment has no VAPID keys.

delete.description: Removes the caller's own subscription with this endpoint. Another member's subscription is never touched, and one that is already gone is not an error.

get.description: `botUsername` is null when the deployment has not configured it, in which case the web app shows the code to send to the bot instead of a link.

post.summary: Get a code to connect my Telegram account
post.description: Valid for an hour and replaces any earlier code. Opening `url` starts a chat with the bot that links the account; without a configured bot username, send `/start <code>` to the bot instead.

delete.description: Also cancels a code that has not been used yet.

post.summary: Get a code to link the house group (admin)
post.description: Valid for an hour and replaces any earlier code. An admin adds the bot to the house group and sends `command` there.

delete.description: Also cancels a code that has not been used yet.
